explanation: Cooks curdle hot milk with lemon juice or vinegar, then press the curds. Paneer softens in a curry but does not melt, so its cubes hold their shape.

claims.text: Paneer is a fresh, unaged cheese.
Paneer is not soya bean curd, a lentil cake or a rice dumpling.
Paneer is made by curdling hot milk with an acid such as lemon juice or vinegar and pressing the curds.
Paneer softens when cooked but does not melt.
